game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Helper Factory: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the refactor_score value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about refactor_score to power up the sled courier and open the sleigh.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Helper Factory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Helper Factory' (Week 6 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Frosted Chapel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how refactor_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
